title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-18
lineage: FOB Nak 700's > MAC > Nak Dragon > HHB cdr 800 > CDR > EAC > wav > SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 show captured on a solid audience tape – Bertha, Sugar Magnolia and Let It Grow blaze while the recording is clear enough for loud listening despite a slightly hollow start.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently hot, with Jerry’s “smokin’” guitar from the opening Bertha through a stellar Promised Land and an all‑time‑great Sugar Magnolia. The audience (AUD) source is generally clean and well balanced, though the early Bertha sounds a bit distant and some track labeling is confused. Overall fans rave about the tight bandwork and high energy of this 1982 concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars, praising both the show’s high energy and the decent audience recording; minor issues (hollow start, track mis‑labeling) keep it from perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall mix with good treble/bass balance; early Bertha sounds distant and a bit hollow. Some track mis‑labeling caused confusion, but the majority of the tape is listenable and suitable for loud playback.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set shines with strong openings; second set maintains momentum. Transitions are tight and the energy stays high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “smokin’” all night, perfect tone from the opening solo on Bertha, consistently tasteful and powerful.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for his “Quake Space” and strong bass presence during the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for nailing Promised Land with solid rhythm work.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard highlights are noted, adding fine color especially on Promised Land.
